title: Museo De Las Americas

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Summer Arts + Culture Camp is a three-week program where 65 students ages 4-11 celebrate cultural & ethnic diversity and immerse themselves in a multidisciplinary, arts-integrated program that includes dance, theater, music, and visual arts to be able to explore the wonder and magic of this year’s focus, Community. This year is extra special for Museo since we are turning 35, and that’s why we want to celebrate our biggest supporters, our community. Museo’s Summer Art and Culture Camp for kids seeks to develop and build cultural competencies that contribute to their emotional, social, and behavioral well-being. The camp’s curriculum relies heavily on the concept of embodied cognition,

services.name: Exhibit Openings
services.desc: Museo de las Americas’ traveling exhibitions program seeks to bring Museo’s collection into public spaces for the community to experience in an unexpected setting. Through collaboration with public institutions, Museo is able to educate the public about the arts and culture of Latin America, as well as display the otherwise hidden collection of Museo de las Americas in an unrestricted space. El programa de exposiciones itinerantes del Museo de las Américas busca llevar la colección del Museo a espacios públicos para que la comunidad pueda experimentar estas exposiciones en un entorno inesperado. services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Art has a long history of bringing people together from all backgrounds and walks of life. So what better place is there to gather for events and successfully foster a sense of community than amidst beautiful Latin American art? To us, there is no comparison. For this reason, Museo de las Americas is happy to offer our art museum here in Denver as a stunning event space rental for private events. Whether that’s a private party, corporate retreat, wedding, or something else entirely, our art museum venue will ensure your attendees are wowed. The atmosphere of our Denver venue rental is undeniable and is bound to bring a unique feel to any personal or professional occasion you are planning.
